channel.title: Lancashire Council Transparency — AI DOGE
channel.description: Independent analysis of Lancashire County Council spending and governance.

item.title: Lancashire Cc Spending: Year-by-Year Trends and What They Reveal
item.description: Lancashire County Council's total spending increased by £812.8 million from 2024 to 2025, a rise of 56.6%.

item.title: Inside Lancashire Cc's Departments: Where Every Pound Goes
item.description: Lancashire County Council spent £245.0 million on OP-Residential Long Term Placements, the highest of any department.

item.title: Reform UK at LCC: 9 Months of Transformation by the Numbers
item.description: From a £28 million inherited overspend to near zero. From 48% savings delivery to 100% target. From maximum council tax rises to the lowest in 12 years. Here's what Reform UK has actually delivered at Lancashire County Council — with the data to prove it.

item.title: The £350 Million Bond Scandal the Conservatives Concealed
item.description: £519 million invested in VeLTIP bonds now worth an estimated £169 million — a paper loss of £350 million that the previous Conservative administration failed to transparently report to councillors or the public. Reform exposed the true scale.

item.title: Council Tax Myth Busted: Reform's 3.80% vs the Conservatives' Seven Years of Maximum Rises
item.description: Critics claim Reform 'broke a promise' on council tax. The data tells a different story: the Conservatives raised council tax to the legal maximum in 7 of their 8 years in control, including the highest rise in Lancashire's history at 5.99%. Reform's 3.80% is the lowest in 12 years.

item.title: Care Homes: How Reform Saved All Five After Years of Underinvestment
item.description: Reform inherited a consultation process already in the pipeline. After years of Conservative underinvestment, they listened to 1,600+ residents and saved all 5 care homes — pledging new investment despite inheriting a £50M savings requirement.

item.title: Pension Fund Reform: How Councillor Director Salaries Were Stopped
item.description: Reform stopped Councillors receiving tens of thousands of pounds in salaries for being directors of LCC pension fund companies — a practice under the previous Conservative administration. The national DOGE team is providing advisory support on bond valuations and fee analysis.

item.title: Fact-Checking the Media: What Byline Times and North West Bylines Got Wrong About Reform at LCC
item.description: Headlines claiming Reform would 'bin DOGE' and 'preside over £46 million overspend' don't survive contact with the actual financial data. The overspend was inherited — and Reform eliminated it. The DOGE efficiency review identified £22 million in savings. Here are the facts.
